footer.about: Honest skincare made in small batches. Cream jars, clear labels, and formulas that respect the skin barrier.

slide-1.heading: Skin that feels rested, every morning
slide-1.body: Gentle formulas built around a few honest ingredients. Nothing you don’t need, everything you do.

slide-2.heading: A calmer routine for warmer days
slide-2.body: Lightweight moisture, mineral sun care and a mist you will keep in your bag.

slide-3.heading: Small batches. Clear labels. Real results.
